pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄹ지언정 (Even If / Even Though - Firm Determination)
meaningEn: Expressing that even if a harsh condition is true, one will never yield or change resolve ('even if / even though').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan bahwa meskipun kondisi yang sangat berat terjadi, seseorang tidak akan menyerah atau mengubah pendirian ('walaupun / biarpun').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ지언정 / Consonant stem -> ~을지언정. Noun: Noun + 일지언정.
notesEn.usage: High-level formal/literary connector used to state unwavering conviction or refusal to compromise.
notesEn.nuance: Emphasizes absolute refusal in the following clause (e.g., 'Even if I starve, I will never steal').

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ지언정 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을지언정. Kata Benda: Kata Benda + 일지언정.
notesId.usage: Kata penghubung formal/sastra tingkat tinggi yang digunakan untuk menyatakan pendirian yang teguh atau penolakan untuk berkompromi.
notesId.nuance: Menekankan penolakan mutlak pada klausa berikutnya (contoh: 'Biarpun saya kelaparan, saya tidak akan pernah mencuri').

examples.hangul: 굶어 죽을지언정 남의 것을 탐내지는 않겠다.
examples.romaja: gul-meo jug-eul-ji-eon-jeong nam-ui geos-eul tam-nae-ji-neun an-gaes-da.
examples.meaningEn: Even if I starve to death, I will never covet what belongs to others.
examples.meaningId: Biarpun mati kelaparan, saya tidak akan mengingini milik orang lain.

examples.meaningEn: Even though I may lose my life, I will not compromise with injustice.
examples.meaningId: Walaupun kehilangan nyawa, saya tidak akan berkompromi dengan ketidakadilan.

examples.meaningEn: Even if I fail, I will never give up.
examples.meaningId: Meskipun gagal, saya tidak akan pernah menyerah.

quiz.question: Which connector expresses firm determination despite severe adversity ('even if... never')?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ지언정 shows strong resolve not to yield even under extreme hardship.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ지언정 menunjukkan tekad kuat untuk tidak menyerah bahkan di bawah kesulitan ekstrem.

pattern: Verb Stem + ~기/게 십상이다 vs ~기 짝이 없다 (Review/Synthesis)
meaningEn: Expressing a formal rhetorical limitation or inevitability.
meaningId: Mengekspresikan batasan atau kepastian retoris formal.

notesEn.formation: Verb Stem + ~기 짝이 없다 vs ~기 십상이다.
notesEn.usage: Used in academic discourse to emphasize extreme states vs high negative probability.
notesEn.nuance: ~기 짝이 없다 = unmatched quality/emotion; ~기 십상이다 = easy/apt to fall into a trap.

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar Kata Kerja + ~기 짝이 없다 vs ~기 십상이다.
notesId.usage: Digunakan dalam wacana akademik untuk menekankan kondisi ekstrem vs probabilitas negatif yang tinggi.
notesId.nuance: ~기 짝이 없다 = kualitas/emosi tak tertandingi; ~기 십상이다 = rawan/mudah jatuh ke dalam jebakan.

examples.hangul: 근거 없는 주장은 비판을 받기 십상입니다.
examples.romaja: geun-geo eob-neun ju-jang-eun bi-pan-eul bat-gi sip-sang-im-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: Groundless claims are apt to receive criticism.
examples.meaningId: Klaim tanpa dasar sangat rawan mendapat kritik.

examples.hangul: 학술적 가치가 없어 안타깝기 짝이 없습니다.
examples.romaja: hak-sul-jeok ga-chi-ga eob-seo an-ta-kkap-gi jjak-i eobs-seum-ni-da.
examples.meaningEn: It is matchlessly regrettable that it lacks academic value.
examples.meaningId: Sangat amat disayangkan bahwa hal itu tidak memiliki nilai akademis.

examples.meaningEn: Hasty conclusions are prone to making errors.
examples.meaningId: Kesimpulan yang tergesa-gesa sangat rawan membuat kesalahan.

quiz.question: Which pattern completes 'Groundless claims are apt to receive criticism'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~기 십상이다 specifically highlights vulnerability to negative results like receiving criticism.
quiz.explanationId: ~기 십상이다 secara khusus menyoroti kerawanan terhadap hasil negatif seperti mendapat kritik.

pattern: Verb Stem + ~아/어 마지않다 vs ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 (High Formal Tone Mastery)
meaningEn: Distinguishing between unceasing expression of heart (~아/어 마지않다) vs humble limitation (~(으)ㄹ 따름이다).
meaningId: Membedakan antara ungkapan perasaan tak henti-hentinya (~아/어 마지않다) vs batasan kerendahan hati (~(으)ㄹ 따름이다).

notesEn.formation: ~아/어 마지않다 (Active heartfelt state) vs ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 (Humble boundary).
notesEn.usage: Essential in high formal writing, speeches, and academic declarations.
notesEn.nuance: Use 마지않다 for deep active devotion/congratulation; use 따름이다 for passive obligation/gratitude limitation.

notesId.formation: ~아/어 마지않다 (Kondisi tulus aktif) vs ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 (Batasan rendah hati).
notesId.usage: Sangat penting dalam tulisan formal tinggi, pidato, dan deklarasi akademis.
notesId.nuance: Gunakan 마지않다 untuk pengabdian/ucapan tulus mendalam; gunakan 따름이다 untuk batasan rasa syukur/kewajiban pasif.

meaningEn: Formulating a high-level academic condition or foundational principle ('inasmuch as / whereas').
meaningId: Mermuskan kondisi akademis tingkat tinggi atau prinsip dasar ('mengingat bahwa / sejauh').

notesEn.usage: Used in formal debate or thesis writing to introduce undisputed premises.
notesEn.nuance: Establishes a logical foundation before presenting the main assertion.

notesId.usage: Digunakan dalam debat formal atau penulisan skripsi untuk memperkenalkan premis yang tidak terbantahkan.
notesId.nuance: Mendirikan fondasi logis sebelum menyajikan penegasan utama.

examples.hangul: 진리가 변하지 않을진대 진실은 밝혀질 것이다.

pattern: Verb Stem + ~을/ㄹ 리 만무하다 vs ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 (Advanced Disbelief Comparison)
meaningEn: Expressing absolute absolute zero logic vs standard impossibility.
meaningId: Mengekspresikan nol kemungkinan logis mutlak vs ketidakmungkinan standar.

notesEn.formation: ~(으)ㄹ 리 만무하다 (100% zero possibility) vs ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 (standard disbelief).
notesEn.usage: Use 만무하다 in formal essays, legal arguments, or literature to state non-existence of possibility emphatically.

notesId.formation: ~(으)ㄹ 리 만무하다 (100% nol kemungkinan) vs ~(으)ㄹ 리가 없다 (keraguan standar).
notesId.usage: Gunakan 만무하다 dalam esai formal, argumen hukum, atau sastra untuk menyatakan ketiadaan kemungkinan secara tegas.
notesId.nuance: 만무 (萬無) meningkatkan nada bicara secara signifikan.

examples.meaningId: Sama sekali tidak mungkin seorang ahli tidak mengetahui hal tersebut.

quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 리 만무하다 is the most emphatic literary form declaring zero possibility.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 리 만무하다 adalah bentuk sastra paling tegas yang menyatakan nol kemungkinan.

constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan ahli (전문가가) + hal itu (그것을) + penjelas tidak tahu lampau (몰랐을) + sama sekali tak mungkin (리 만무합니다).
